dedupe_keys.name: national statistical committee of kyrgyzstan housing stock equipment tables share of housing with water supply sewerage central heating gas hot water and electric stoves by region urban and rural 2010 to 2023 and the 2022 population and housing census regional books

description: The National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic publishes housing stock tables as XLS downloads in its housing statistics section. One table gives, for every year from 2010 to 2023, the share of housing equipped with water supply, sewerage, central heating, bath or shower, gas, hot water, electric stoves and telephone, for each oblast and the cities of Bishkek and Osh, split into urban and rural areas. In 2010 only 33.7 percent of the national stock had piped water and 14.8 percent central heating, against 4.4 and 1.1 percent in Osh oblast. A second table tracks floor area with each amenity since 1990. The committee also posts the Book III regional volumes of the 2022 Population and Housing Census, with population by district and settlement; their annex shows the housing questionnaire on electricity, gas, heating type, water, sewerage and hot water. Coverage is national by region. Format and access: free XLS and PDF, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the census volume on housing conditions (Book IV) was announced but not found in the archive; the percentage table does not state its base in the rows read, while the second table is in floor area. Simulation uses: heating and water network coverage by region. Related records: none for Kyrgyzstan statistics in the catalogue.
